items.hed: The 7-2 Rockets play at Phoenix Saturday night looking for their sixth straight win
items.insight: The league schedule lists Houston at Phoenix Saturday, Nov. 7, at 9:00 p.m. Eastern at the Suns' arena in downtown Phoenix. Houston enters at 7-2; Phoenix is 2-5. Houston's next home game is Monday, Nov. 9, against Denver at Toyota Center.

items.hed: Texans play the winless Chargers Sunday afternoon at SoFi Stadium
items.insight: The club's official game page says kickoff is Sunday, Nov. 8, at 3:05 p.m. Central at SoFi Stadium, broadcast on NFL Network and CBS. Los Angeles enters the game at 0-7. A Saturday injury report from the Chargers' side cleared four defenders to play this week, according to a report citing the team's final designations.
items.image_caption: NRG Stadium interior. Ed Schipul, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 2.0.

items.hed: Astros GM Randy Flores is still working the manager search, with Albert Pujols and Morgan Ensberg among the names
items.insight: MLB.com reported this week that Flores, hired as the club's general manager, is interviewing former teammates Albert Pujols and Morgan Ensberg for the opening left by Joe Espada, along with Rangers bench coach Luis Urueta. As of Saturday no hire has been announced. Owner Jim Crane has said the interview process began before Flores was even hired, and reports describe Flores as wanting to move quickly on the choice with the offseason clock already running.
